title: RentGuard Renters Policy Reinstatement Conditions — Decision Table
content:
A cancelled RentGuard Renters Policy may be reinstated only when every condition below holds. Each is judged from the company's records of the policy — its cancellation reason and date, its premium account and its signature requests.

## Conditions in force

| # | Condition | Record it rests on |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | The policy was cancelled for nonpayment. A policy cancelled at the insured's request is never reinstated and must be rewritten as a new policy. | the cancellation reason on the policy |
| 2 | The reinstatement request is made no later than the reinstatement window that starts on the cancellation date. | the cancellation date recorded as the policy's closed date |
| 3 | The policy's reinstatements in the rolling 12 months are fewer than the tier's reinstatement allowance. | reinstatement reversal entries on the premium account |
| 4 | The named insured has signed a statement of no loss covering the days since the cancellation date. | the signature request for the statement of no loss |

**Counting the window.** The window is counted in calendar days from the cancellation date recorded as the closed date, using the tier's reinstatement window; its last day is the cancellation date plus that many days, and a request on the last day of the window is on time.

**Counting reinstatements.** Each reinstatement shows on the premium account as one additional premium entry with change reason reinstatement reversal. The rolling 12 months end on the reinstatement request date: an entry counts when it was posted later than the request date less 12 calendar months and on or before the request date.

## Retired clauses

The following clauses of this rule are **no longer in force**; they have been withdrawn and superseded by the current basis for the reinstatement cure payment and for recording a reinstatement:

- "Before reinstatement, payments received since the cancellation date must cover the amount due as of the request date plus the reinstatement fee."
- "Reinstatement is without a lapse: the term is unchanged, the reinstatement fee is charged, and the cancellation credit is reversed by one additional premium entry with change reason reinstatement reversal for the same amount, referencing that credit and dated the reinstatement date."

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; window of 15 days)

| Cancellation date | Request date | On time |
|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 16 March (last day of the window) | yes |
| 1 March | 17 March | no |

## Further hypothetical cases

- A policy cancelled at the named insured's request after a move is not reinstated, however soon the request comes; it is rewritten as a new policy.
- On a tier allowing 1 reinstatement per rolling 12 months, a policy whose last reinstatement reversal entry was posted 10 months before the request is not reinstated; one whose last entry was posted 13 months before it may be.

superseded_clauses: Before reinstatement, payments received since the cancellation date must cover renters_msr_amount_due as of the request date plus the reinstatement fee.

Reinstatement is without a lapse: the term is unchanged, the reinstatement fee is charged, and the cancellation credit is reversed by one renters_additional_premium entry with change_reason reinstatement_reversal for the same amount, referencing that credit and dated the reinstatement date.
